SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

Echo speaker prototype: J12 connects the controller to the sensor harness in a speaker battery-interface prototype.
Operator note: an intermittent link interruption was reported during drop handling.

No drop handling test record accompanies this note.
Baseline revision and J12 pin mapping are not recorded.
Independent review is pending.
